name: Alert Callout
description: An accessible info/success/warning/error callout with an icon, optional title, body content, and an optional dismiss button.
usage: Import AlertCallout and render <AlertCallout variant="warning" title="Heads up">Body text…</AlertCallout>; pass onDismiss to make it dismissible. Variants info/success use role=status (polite) and warning/error use role=alert (assertive) automatically.
